page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz across 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. The instance supplies 128 GiB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GiB per core. The processor includes 33 MB of shared L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and instruction set support for AVX and AVX-512F. Network connectivity is rated at a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Local storage is not bundled, requiring external network block storage volumes for persistent data.

Performance testing indicates balanced mid-tier execution speeds across compute and memory subsystems. In synthetic testing, the instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,613 and a PassMark CPU score of 34,102.79, placing it firmly within the middle 50 percent of its class. Memory throughput tests show uncached sequential read speeds of 152.43 GB/sec and write speeds of 69.06 GB/sec. Application-oriented tests recorded 31.0 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 26.9 GB/sec. Small language model text generation reached 297.4 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model, ranking in the top quartile, though medium 7B inference operates at an average 18.36 tokens per second.

From a resource utilization standpoint, the instance delivers predictable, dedicated compute threads without the cost premium associated with specialized memory-heavy or GPU-accelerated configurations. The absence of integrated NVMe drives eliminates idle storage expense for workloads that rely exclusively on detached block or object storage. With its 1:4 resource balance, the instance is appropriate for enterprise web serving, backend application servers, clang software compilation tasks, intermediate database processing, and general enterprise container clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs spanning 16 physical cores, 128 GiB of RAM, 33 MB of L3 cache, and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance includes hardware support for AVX and AVX-512F instructions, but contains no local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying on external network storage for disk operations. Benchmark results place its multi-core CPU and memory throughput within the average mid-tier bracket, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,613 and 31.0 million Redis SET operations per second. Its balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio provides cost-efficient scaling for workloads with symmetric resource demands, making it well matched for multi-threaded software compilation, enterprise web applications, intermediate relational databases, and containerized backend microservices.
